data.body: Kickoff/resume: single code leaf irongray-unlucky-discus, six recorded file-impact paths, worktree /Users/joeoakhart/prepare-comment-echo-reclaim-93c4 on branch prepare-comment-echo-reclaim-93c4 at current origin/main e330e286b007. Landing method is one Gerrit change with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 before submit/close. Inherited manifest builder and tests had no recorded RED run, so they receive no RED-first credit and are being treated as an untrusted draft; new or strengthened contract behavior will be proven RED-first. Manifest test card: authority=ticket semantic oracle and exact incident tuple; preconditions=clean standalone unfiltered non-promisor Git repo, exact tip, verified off-repo bundle/manifest, complete Jira pagination, stable remote refs; production path=incident builder and real Git plumbing with only Jira represented by captured production-shaped JSON; tier=integration with real temporary source/bare remote because refs/blobs/bundles are contractual; exact postcondition=canonical deterministic immutable manifest selecting one live Jira identity and enumerating exact removals/transforms; collateral invariants=source worktree/ref and authoritative remote unchanged, bridge mapping protected, non-target material unchanged; contrast=ambiguous/incomplete/moving/shared/dirty/promisor inputs refuse without output; gate=focused pytest plus make test. Surface census: script CLI is in scope and needs subprocess coverage; MCP/API, public library, automated reconcilers/bots, and dual-direction mirror are out of scope because this is incident-specific offline preparation tooling with no production registration, caller, write surface, or inverse operation.
